description: This file defines the PurgeEntities command class used for purging entities of a specific type by their IDs in the Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing JSON representations, and managing command metadata.

classes.name: PurgeEntities
classes.description: Immutable class representing a command to purge entities of a specific type by their IDs within the Ditto framework.

classes.name: PurgeEntities.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions specific to the PurgeEntities command schema.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new PurgeEntities instance with specified entity type, IDs, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a PurgeEntities command instance from a JSON object representation.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type targeted by the purge command.

methods.name: getEntityIds
methods.description: Returns the list of entity IDs to be purged.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated headers.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Generates the topic string corresponding to the entity type for messaging.
